summary: Standard Lithium Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 11, 2026 press release announcing that director Karen Narwold will resign from the board effective September 15, 2026, after accepting a new executive position with increased time commitments. The resignation is characterized as voluntary and amicable, not a disagreement over operations, policies or practices. Following the departure, the board will comprise eight directors, and the company has initiated a search for a new independent director, targeting a complementary appointment. Neither the TSXV nor NYSE American listing is affected; no financial terms, advisors or regulatory clocks apply. Watch for the successor appointment and any further board turnover.
